description.zh:
数据库ID。
> 该参数对应为[SearchDatabase](~~141876~~)、[ListDatabases](~~141873~~)、[GetDatabase](~~141869~~)等接口中的DatabaseId参数，您可以调用这些接口获取。
description.en:
The database ID.

> Call these operations to obtain the database ID: [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~), [ListDatabases](~~141873~~), and [GetDatabase](~~141869~~).
Specifies whether the database is a logical database.

description.zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见[指定API调用者](~~2835451~~)。</props>
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the API caller.<props="china"> For more information, see [Specify the caller of an API operation](~~2835451~~).</props>

description.zh: 要执行的具体SQL脚本。包括DQL、DDL和DML，其中DDL和DML是否允许依赖于实例的安全管控配置。
description.en: The SQL script to execute. You can specify Data Query Language (DQL), Data Definition Language (DDL), or Data Manipulation Language (DML) statements. The ability to execute DDL and DML statements depends on the instance's security settings.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, move the cursor over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).

descriptions.zh:
- 目前仅支持开启安全托管的实例调用该API。开启安全托管操作，请参见[安全托管](~~2637012~~)。

- 目前不支持NoSQL类型的数据库调用此API。
descriptions.en:
- This operation applies only to instances with Security Collaboration enabled. To enable Security Collaboration, see [Security Collaboration](~~2637012~~).

- This API operation is not supported for NoSQL databases.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise execute-script --db-id 123 --script select_dt_from_report_daily --logic false --tid 234 --real-login-user-uid 214004479568670000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise ExecuteScript --region cn-hangzhou --Script select_dt_from_report_daily --DbId 123 --RealLoginUserUid 214004479568670000 --Logic false --Tid 234
